title: From Temperature-Limited to Battery-Limited Legged Locomotion
abstract: arXiv:2611.22231v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On legged robots, sustained locomotion often ends in thermal shutdown rather than battery depletion: the heat of walking concentrates in a few joint motors, which overheat long before the battery is empty. We train thermally aware locomotion policies by reinforcement learning without ever observing temperature, and demonstrate this on a Unitree Go2 quadruped. We first identify a coupled 13-node lumped RC thermal network, fitted on two runs of a single robot and calibrated against the measured electrical power, that predicts all twelve motor temperatures with a mean RMSE below 1 $^\circ$C across different robot instances, gaits, payloads, and speeds. Under a sustained gait, the temperatures the motors will settle at follow directly from the gait-averaged squared torques and joint speeds. translated_title: 从温度受限到电池受限的腿式运动
translated_abstract: 在腿式机器人上，持续运动往往以热关机而非电池耗尽告终：行走产生的热量集中在少数几个关节电机中，这些电机在电池耗尽之前很久就会过热。我们通过强化学习训练热感知的运动策略，而无需观测温度，并在宇树（Unitree）Go2四足机器人上进行了验证。我们首先辨识了一个耦合的13节点集总RC热网络，该网络基于单台机器人的两次运行数据进行拟合，并利用测量的电功率进行校准，能够在不同机器人个体、步态、载荷和速度条件下预测全部十二个电机的温度，平均RMSE低于1°C。在持续步态下，电机最终将达到的稳定温度可直接由步态平均的平方扭矩和关节速度推得。我们的核心贡献是一个奖励函数，它压低最热电机的预测稳态温度：热时间常数超出了强化学习的信用分配视野……
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需观测温度的热感知强化学习运动策略，通过奖励函数压低最热电机的预测稳态温度，使腿式机器人的持续运动从热关机限制转变为电池续航限制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a thermally aware reinforcement learning locomotion policy that operates without observing temperature, using a reward that drives down the hottest predicted steady-state motor temperatures, shifting sustained legged locomotion from thermal shutdown limits to battery endurance limits.
